I'm writing this post since, recently, I've taken to browsing 8chan's /cow/ board and the Kiwi Farms because, much to my chagrin, several of the colorful and in some cases possibly insane individuals they have commented on have cross into my own life, and frankly, I really am not a fan of their drama, so I figure since knowledge is power, keeping track of communities like that is my best defense against it happening further.

It was while browsing the former I saw one of those Russian spambot links to child pornography sites (from what I understand, this happens often, which they have been trying to eliminate for some time now). Being a law abiding citizen with an intense hatred of the abusers of children, I immediately decided to report all links and text data from the post I to a law enforcement agency for followup.

According to US law, doing this is perfectly legal, and generally, it's assumed if you stumble across child pornography by sheer accident or links to it and you immediately inform law enforcement and follow their explicit instructions for reporting such content, you are obeying the law.

Here's are the do's and don't

  1. If in the US, you need to report all such activity here:

http://www.missingkids.org/cybertipline

Similar sites exist for Canada and European countries, look this information up and follow their instructions to the letter.

Include all information they request, including where you saw it, how you came across the information, and any further information that may be helpful to getting it taken down.

In my case, I copied all the text data from the spambot post, including all the links it had (included was a image thumbnail with another link, I included that link as well) and submitted it with my report.

I also ran a google search for the terms listed in the spambot post to see if any other links on the Internet matched it, found two, and included them in my report as well.

  1. Do not, under any circumstances, visit the links nor save any images with child pornography, even if you "blur" them like Dan Olsen did or want to prove what you found to law enforcement. This is considered furthering the distribution of such material and is expressly illegal no matter your motives. Merely report them and under what circumstances you find them so law enforcement can track down the source and deal with it. I repeat, what Dan Olsen did was illegal and very stupid, do not do the same.

  2. If you run across any images that are child pornographic, do not, as listed above, save copies of them in any way. In fact, purge them ASAP. In the US, doing so immediately and not attempting to purposely look it up again means you are fine. Purposely seeking out that material again (such as following links to child porn or pulling an Olsen and distributing it somehow) will get you screwed over royally by the authorities. In the case of those spambot links, merely seeing the spam alone does not count against you, since that is illegal content posted in a public place by a third party for whom you are not responsible. You do become party to their illegality if you click on the links they advertise or save any illegal images they post in any way. In short, neither 8chan or you are responsible for those spambots, unless either of you further their spread of illegal content.

Since this happened to me recently, I felt it prudent to share how I handled it so I and other responsible users of the internet who oppose child abuse can assist the authorities in dealing with it.

In fact, in all my recent browsing of 8chan, those spambots were the only thing I saw that came closest to actual child porn being distributed intentionally, and by doing the above to report that content will make sure you stay on the right side of the law and deny perverts like Nyberg more material for their fap folders.
How to avoid being Dan Olsen, Nick Nyberg and like the other pedophiles and their defenders and report child pornography lawfully (A PSA for GamerGaters and everyone else disgusted by pedophiles)
